QECTOR Workbench

QECTOR Workbench is a free desktop application and Model Context Protocol server. The published Windows release is v1.0.1 with an 85-tool server and qector-decoder-v3 1.0.0 backend; the published Linux release is v1.0.1 with an 85-tool server and a 1.0.0 backend. Both builds ship 17 decoder kinds and 10 code families. No macOS build is currently published.

Downloads

  • Windows x64: v1.0.1 portable QectorWorkbench-Portable.exe: github.com/qectorlab/qector-decoder-workbench-windows
  • Linux x64: v1.0.1 AppImage plus Debian packages for Ubuntu/Debian/Mint and antiX/MX: github.com/qectorlab/qector-decoder-workbench-linux
  • Headless MCP server on either platform: --mcp; MCP protocol 2024-11-05 over stdio JSON-RPC 2.0.
  • SHA-256 checksums for every released file are published in the release notes.

Workspaces

The Windows v1.0.1 release documents eight GUI tabs plus a live Console: Code Explorer, Decoder Lab, Benchmark, Batch & Streaming, Hardware, Diagnostics, Documentation, Lab & Personal Info, and Console. The Linux build adds a History tab. Use each release's manuals for platform-specific details.

10 Quantum Code Families

The published Workbench releases cover 10 code families including qLDPC and colour codes:

  • repetition: 1D chain parity-check code.
  • ring: Periodic 1D chain.
  • rotated_surface: Standard rotated surface code.
  • unrotated_surface: Square lattice surface code.
  • toric: Toric code with periodic boundaries.
  • heavy_hex: heavy-hex lattice.
  • hypergraph_product: CSS code from repetition seed.
  • bicycle: qLDPC bicycle code.
  • bivariate_bicycle: bivariate bicycle presets (qLDPC).
  • color_code: triangular colour code.

Local measurement

No hardware-specific measurement data is published on this site. If you run optional local tools, record the workload, environment, and raw artifact with the result.
